limits: Permutation preserves the marginal level distribution but not every structural property of the block.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

what_this_establishes.the_check_that_was_missing: the random block controls capacity but is white noise, so it cannot tell 'any structured block of this width helps' from 'this particular mapping helps'. Permuting the drug-to-pathway assignment keeps the width and the level distribution and breaks only the assignment.
what_this_establishes.reading: the permuted block behaves exactly like the random one, and the direct real-versus-permuted contrast is significant in both pools, so the gain comes from the specific drug-pathway assignment

the_full_case_for_the_claim.direction: eight independent split sets, all positive and significant (R122 through R126)
the_full_case_for_the_claim.capacity: a matched random block is never significant in any pool or round
the_full_case_for_the_claim.structure: a permuted block of the same width and level distribution is never significant, and real minus permuted is significant
the_full_case_for_the_claim.condition: present only when both drugs are unseen; with one drug seen, identity already reaches 55 to 56 percent and the block adds nothing
the_full_case_for_the_claim.internal_control: the tissue block delivers exactly zero when its columns are absent, showing the pipeline can detect a dead block

what_this_means_for_promotion.within_dataset_checks: exhausted: direction, capacity, structure, condition and dead-block control have all been run
what_this_means_for_promotion.remaining_blocker: only the missing second dataset, which C78 and C89 established cannot be built from BATCHIE across three arenas and three units
what_this_means_for_promotion.honest_status: the claim is as well supported as this machine allows and still not promotable, because the promotion rule requires cross-dataset replication and no usable second resource exists
